title: skills/objectstack-data + data-engine docs: an update whose every caller field is dropped writes nothing and runs no afterUpdate (after #34746)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibwJEh7hMPPvagWM1g7

Filing gate ①: Skills-docs follow-up owed by PR #35594 (#34746), declared there as `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md, content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`. Source: fleet. Dedupe: `afterUpdate dropped skills` → 2 hits (#34746 itself, the triage seat post), no open card.

Blocked-by: #35594

Grade: area:data · documentation · p3 · inherits the detail grade of #34746 (p2) one step down: the docs do not teach the old behaviour; they omit the new one.

## What changes once #35594 lands

An update whose every caller-supplied key is taken by an engine strip (static `readonly`, a TRUE `readonlyWhen`, computed, primary key) is a no-op: no driver write, no `updated_at` / `updated_by` stamp, no `afterUpdate`, no roll-up recompute, no realtime event. By id it answers the current record; by predicate it answers 0. The drops are still reported (`droppedFields`, `onFieldsDropped`). A key a `beforeUpdate` hook wrote survives, so that update is not all-dropped. Strict mode (`strictReadonlyWrites`) still refuses first.

## The gap

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`: the event table (~L36) says `afterUpdate` runs after updating a record; the dropped-field table (~L367-400) lists the strips but not that an all-dropped update skips `afterUpdate`. An agent writing an "on update" automation would expect it to fire for a form that submits only locked fields.
- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`: the update contract does not state the no-op.

## Ask

One sentence beside the dropped-field table in each file (the rule above, the by-id / predicate answers), and regenerate any served copy (`*.generated.ts`). Text only; run the skills gates (`check-skill-*`).

## Readers

The `domain:skills` lane seat claims it after #35594 merges.

Re-check: `git grep -n -i "afterUpdate" origin/main -- skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md content/docs/kernel/contracts/data-engine.mdx`
